_comment: Classes and their features, from the 5e SRD (see docs/SPELLS.md). 'features' and 'spells' list what each level adds; a character gains them on reaching that level. 'slots': 'full' uses the full-caster spell slot table.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.description: A bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. Once per short rest.

action_surge.name: Action Surge
action_surge.description: Take one more action this turn. Once per short rest.

expertise.name: Expertise
expertise.description: Double proficiency bonus when picking locks with thieves' tools.

sneak_attack.name: Sneak Attack
sneak_attack.description: Once a turn, extra damage with a finesse or ranged weapon when you have advantage or an ally is next to the target.

cunning_action.name: Cunning Action
cunning_action.description: Dash or Disengage as a bonus action.

arcane_recovery.name: Arcane Recovery
arcane_recovery.description: Once a day, during a short rest, recover spell slots whose levels add up to half your wizard level (rounded up).

divine_domain.name: Divine Domain: Life
divine_domain.description: A priest of the dawn, devoted to life and healing.

disciple_of_life.name: Disciple of Life
disciple_of_life.description: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore an extra 2 + the spell's level hit points.

channel_divinity.name: Channel Divinity
channel_divinity.description: Channel divine power: Turn Undead or Preserve Life. Once per short rest.

turn_undead.name: Turn Undead
turn_undead.description: Each undead within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or flees for a minute (until it takes damage).

preserve_life.name: Preserve Life
preserve_life.description: Share out 5 × cleric level hit points among allies within 30 feet, none above half their maximum.
